elements.name: Line
elements.symptom: Inconsistent baselines, stray borders, misleading directional cues
elements.remediation: Prefer alignment and meaningful dividers; decorative lines should not obscure focus outlines.

elements.name: Shape
elements.symptom: Controls and illustrations have conflicting shape languages
elements.remediation: Keep component silhouettes stable; do not rely on shape alone to identify status.

elements.name: Form
elements.symptom: Illogical elevation or pseudo-3D styles imply wrong clickability
elements.remediation: Tie elevation to layering and interaction; avoid false affordances.

elements.name: Color
elements.role: carry mood, emphasis and semantic role
elements.symptom: Palette sprawl, low tonal contrast, color-only status
elements.remediation: Use semantic tokens; verify contrast and non-color cues for each state.

elements.name: Value
elements.role: separate foreground and background independent of hue
elements.remediation: Test grayscale and luminance; meet WCAG requirements for meaningful content.

elements.name: Texture
elements.role: add surface distinction or material feeling
elements.symptom: Noise competes with text, patterns increase distraction
elements.remediation: Reserve textures for nonessential backgrounds; verify readability.

elements.name: Space
elements.role: group related elements and create breathing room
elements.symptom: Dense group collisions or excessive wasted traversal
elements.remediation: Use spacing tokens; adjust density to task and preserve responsive grouping.

relationship: Elements are raw visual properties; principles govern their arrangement.
